transcript.content: Hello, I'm Dr. Smith. It's nice to meet you; could you tell me what brings you in to see me today?

Hello. Well... I'm just having some trouble listening, I guess. Like down at the museum, people will be talking right to me about the next art walk, and I’m looking right at them. But then... I realize I just missed the middle of what they said. I end up having to ask them to run it by me again. So... yeah. That's mainly why I'm here.
Does this difficulty with staying focused happen only when you are talking to other people, or do you find it hard to pay attention when you are working on tasks or reading by yourself?

It's not just with people. It happens when I'm by myself, too. Like if I sit down with a gallery packet or some notes... I usually start out fine. But after a few minutes, my eyes are just moving over the page, and my mind has wandered off somewhere else. I just end up having to read the same part again. So... yeah, reading too.
Have you experienced these difficulties with staying focused since you were a child, or is this a more recent development in your life?

It's... it's been a long time. I suppose it was like this when I was a kid, too. My mother... well, she used to have to sit right there next to me when I was doing my homework, just to make sure I got it done. And... I remember my report cards always said things about how I was daydreaming, or that I needed reminders to finish my work. So... yeah, it's not new.
Do you often feel like you have to be constantly on the go, or do you find yourself frequently interrupting others when they are speaking?

No... I wouldn't say that. I'm not really... on the go much. I mostly just take it easy these days. And... no, I don't think I interrupt people. I usually just wait for them to finish talking... even if I didn't catch it all. So... no.
Do you often find that you lose things like your keys, phone, or important documents, or do you have trouble keeping your workspace or personal belongings organized?

Yeah... I suppose I do. I'll put things down... thinking it's a safe spot. Like... a camera battery, or some name tags. Sometimes that envelope with the sign-up sheets. And then... well, I just end up spending half the morning retracing my steps to find them again. So... yes.
Do you find yourself putting off or avoiding tasks that require a lot of mental effort for a long period, like filling out long forms or preparing reports?

I suppose... yeah. If I know I need to read through a long exhibit description... or try to plan out a talk... I'll usually just find little chores around the house to do first. Just... sitting there with all that reading, it feels like pulling teeth. So... I guess I do avoid it.
When you are working on a task, do you often find that you make careless mistakes or overlook details?
I don't... really think so. I mean, I guess everyone makes a mistake here and there, but... no, nothing stands out. I just do what I need to do.
Do you often find yourself forgetting to do things in your daily routine, like missing appointments, forgetting to pay bills, or forgetting to run errands?
No, not really. I manage my bills fine. And... if I have an appointment, I'll go. I don't really forget that sort of stuff.
